data.one_liner: Generates random fake data like names, addresses, emails, and more for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wide range of faker methods organized in modules (e.g., name, address, internet). It supports multiple locales and can produce unique values. Includes a templating helper to interpolate faker data into strings.
use_when: You need placeholder data for testing UI or seeding databases
You want to quickly generate realistic looking sample content without external services
avoid_when: You require deterministic data for reproducible tests without custom seeding
You need a full-featured data generation library with schema definitions
strengths: Large variety of data types and locales
Simple API with no Flutter-specific dependencies
Can generate unique values and supports templating
weaknesses: Limited to random generation, no schema or model integration
No built‑in support for data persistence or networking
May produce unrealistic data if not carefully configured
